dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about Nod-Krai's Adventurers' Guild...

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: The Guild here has a lot more trouble to deal with than anywhere else in Teyvat.

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: But I chose to stay. And hey, from where I'm standing, I think Nod-Krai might be the best place for adventurers to be.
